title: Planning without a broker login on delayed prices (G-02-2)
reference_behaviour: Without a broker login the builder, ready-mades and payoff still work on prices delayed by one minute, with a banner explaining the delay and how to get real-time prices; trading stays disabled.
ours: Without a Zerodha connection no prices or P&L are shown (Live data not connected). Owner decided in ADR-174 not to copy the delayed feed for now; REQ-105 (row 58) stays held.
